Each cell is the share of that country's scanned government domains that load at least one asset — script, stylesheet, font or media — from that service. Counting distinct domains rather than requests keeps one heavily-crawled site from dominating a row.

Services are ranked by how many countries they appear in. Download the backing data as [JSON](data/dependency-matrix.json) or [CSV](data/dependency-matrix.csv) to reproduce any figure here.
